## Executive Summary
Scale Flow is an independent digital design and development studio headquartered in Connaught Place, New Delhi, India. Founded to eliminate generic, slow, template-driven agency work, Scale Flow builds high-performance, bespoke web experiences with instant transparent pricing in INR. Scale Flow specializes in custom React/Next.js architectures, 3D WebGL interactive experiences, and high-converting e-commerce storefronts for Indian and global startups.

## Technical Differentiators
- **PageSpeed Optimization**: Every deployment targets 95–100 Mobile and Desktop PageSpeed scores with sub-1-second LCP.
- **Accessibility**: 100/100 WCAG AA compliant navigation, ARIA structures, and keyboard accessibility.
- **Frontend Stack**: Modern React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, GSAP with ScrollTrigger, Vite, Nitro server.
- **3D & Creative Engineering**: Custom WebGL/Three.js interactive product visualizers (no static boring images).
- **Payment & Backend Readiness**: Integrated with Razorpay, Cashfree, Stripe, and Node/MySQL production schemas.
